Why they are kept here
  coach_evidence_turn_1.json is the record of what was actually checked. Its
  independent test entry says signal_absent = false, test_command = "skipped",
  with the note "Independent test verification skipped (tests not required for
  documentation tasks)", and its tests entry says tests_required = false. In
  plain words: the separate test run was skipped on purpose, because this kind
  of task does not need tests.

  coach_turn_1.json is what the coach then said: a rejection whose single
  objection quotes "independent_tests.signal_absent=true" — the opposite of
  what the record says. That misreading is what the deterministic check
  AgentInvoker._reconcile_contradicted_absent_test_claim now removes, and it is
  why these two files are pinned here as the test's ground truth rather than
  hand-written stand-ins.

No secrets: both files were scanned for API keys and message-broker URLs
before they were copied (zero matches).
